title: several schema faults report in unstable order
notes: Fixed: `analyze_errors` builds its missing-field and unknown-field lists in document order rather than from set differences, so the three unknown keys report top to bottom and the output no longer depends on `PYTHONHASHSEED`. The `hygiene_unstable_order` flag is gone with the instability. Fix stays 0: none of the three keys is a near miss of anything.
